int_name: N BROAD ST & CECIL B MOORE AVE

result.summary: This intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized control in an institutional/commercial setting. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase exposure for the high volume of pedestrians visible.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cover a wide expanse of roadway without a central refuge, increasing exposure time to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across the zebra markings

hazards.name: High pedestrian volume
hazards.description: Large groups of pedestrians crossing simultaneously can lead to crowding and slower clearing of the intersection during signal cycles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and a central concrete refuge island.
